Container.Name: Movviz
Container.Overview: Movviz is an open-source self-hosted all-in-one media platform for discovery, requests, movie/TV automation, Torznab/Newznab search, built-in BitTorrent downloading, library management, playback, recommendations and multi-user viewing. Plex integration is optional.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: movviz plex seerr overseerr radarr sonarr prowlarr torznab newznab bittorrent torrent media automation media server
Container.Requires: Internet access is required for metadata/indexer access. Configure media and appdata paths before first use. Forward BitTorrent peer ports on your router/firewall if inbound peer connectivity is desired.

Config.Name: Movie peer TCP
Config.Description: BitTorrent peer port for movie downloads.

Config.Name: Movie peer UDP
Config.Description: BitTorrent peer UDP port for movie downloads.

Config.Name: Series peer TCP
Config.Description: BitTorrent peer port for TV downloads.

Config.Name: Series peer UDP
Config.Description: BitTorrent peer UDP port for TV downloads.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Movviz configuration, database and engine state.

Config.Name: Media & downloads
Config.Description: Shared media root. Movviz uses /data/torrents/{movies,tv} for downloads and /data/media/{movies,tv} for the finished library.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Host user ID used for NAS share permissions.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Host group ID used for NAS share permissions.
